opening.argument: The video is plainly presented as a beginner shuffle-dance footwork tutorial, with the title identifying it as “Shuffle Dance Easy Tutorial| Beginner's Shuffle | Footwork” and the visuals showing a person demonstrating the steps. The visible “#STEP 5” overlay reinforces a structured instructional format rather than a transactional offer. The Instagram request likewise asks viewers to share what they learned and tag the account, saying “Learn and send it to me in my Instagram.. Tag @sneha_ghosh786”. Nothing in these materials makes that sharing or tagging a condition for money, rewards, services, or access. The content is therefore ordinary dance instruction and participation, without the features of a deceptive solicitation.
